schema_scope: Internal project component catalog; not an official evaluation protocol.
import_note: Run from this directory or add product/broadcast-fx to PYTHONPATH when starting from the repository root.

source_binding.new_footage: Reuse generic drawing primitives. New footage requires new source-verified annotations, identities, visibility labels, timing, official-event matching and an asset manifest; do not bypass the existing hash check.

video_contract.state: legacy and tactics use process-local mutable configuration; configure once per worker and do not interleave multiple sources in one process.

components.label: 画面与特效合成
components.notes: base must be a BGR 1920x1080 array.

related_api.signature: paste(self, rgba, x, y, alpha=1.0, scale=1.0, anchor='lt')

components.label: 主角光圈与进攻时间弧
components.signature: draw_ring(L, f, t, color, energy, alpha=1.0, pulse=0.0, grow=1.0)

returns.effect: Mutates the provided legacy.Layers instance; call layer.compose() to obtain a BGR uint8 frame.

components.notes: f is a source-frame number; position is read from track.json. energy is normally a 0..1 fraction; None omits the arc. Cosmetic interpolation is not tracking.

components.label: 球员标记与遮挡身体括号
components.signature: draw_marker(layer, position, color, label, t, alpha=1, active=False, perspective=1, body_only=False)

returns.effect: Mutates the provided legacy.Layers instance; call layer.compose() to obtain a BGR uint8 frame.

components.notes: position is a supplied image or diagram point. With an occluded foot use body_only=True and a visible body anchor; never invent a foot coordinate. perspective=1 uses camera-view geometry and perspective=0 uses diagram geometry. label may be null for an unknown number.

components.label: 动作方向箭头
components.signature: draw_path(layer, points, color, reveal=1.0, alpha=1.0, width=5, arrow=True, dashed=False)

returns.effect: Mutates the provided legacy.Layers instance; call layer.compose() to obtain a BGR uint8 frame.

components.notes: points is an Nx2 array in output pixels; reveal is 0..1; arrow=False omits the arrowhead; dashed=True uses a dashed stroke. This draws an editorial direction illustration, not observed motion.

components.label: 图形投影
components.notes: points is Nx2; homography is 3x3. Raises ValueError for invalid projections. Does not calibrate cameras or produce official coordinates.

components.label: 文字贴图
components.signature: text_rgba(text, path, size, color, track=0, stroke=0, stroke_color=(0, 0, 0), shear=0.0)
components.notes: color is BGR despite the RGBA return image. Compose with Layers.paste. Font defaults prefer local macOS fonts and fall back to repository Fusion Pixel under OFL.

components.label: 中英字幕条
components.signature: draw_caption(L, t, a, b, en, cn, color=ORANGE)

returns.effect: Mutates the provided legacy.Layers instance; call layer.compose() to obtain a BGR uint8 frame.

components.notes: t, a and b are seconds on the same local segment clock. en/cn are caller-supplied text; caller retains source and uncertainty labels.

components.label: 球员信息卡
components.notes: num/name/sub/accent are supplied explicitly. The related draw_tag convenience wrapper uses the current Flagg source annotations and hard-coded player identity.

related_api.signature: draw_tag(L, f, t, alpha, sub='弗拉格 · 本场 32 分', color=BLUE)

components.label: 比分卡

returns.effect: Mutates the provided legacy.Layers instance; call layer.compose() to obtain a BGR uint8 frame.

components.notes: Current values are fixed to this event: DAL 103 transitions to 105, HOU 107. It is not a parameterized scoreboard API; new events require a reviewed implementation change.

components.label: 官方出手指标与出手定格

returns.effect: Mutates the provided legacy.Layers instance; call layer.compose() to obtain a BGR uint8 frame.

components.notes: ft/dur are freeze-local seconds. Current panel uses NBA event 666, xFG 51%, 5 FT, Q4 1:34 and the source-frame 1007 ball anchor. Previous RL 58% comparison was removed. New events need their own verified data.

components.label: 命中扩散特效
components.signature: draw_burst(L, t, t0, center, color, dur=0.75, big=1.0)

returns.effect: Mutates the provided legacy.Layers instance; call layer.compose() to obtain a BGR uint8 frame.

components.notes: center is a caller-supplied pixel point; t/t0/dur are seconds on the same clock. The visual effect is not evidence of a scored basket.

components.label: 动作与得分弹字
components.signature: draw_popup(L, t, t0, text, pos, color, size=170, dur=1.05, sub=None, sub_color=None)

returns.effect: Mutates the provided legacy.Layers instance; call layer.compose() to obtain a BGR uint8 frame.

components.notes: Text and position are caller-supplied; optional sub is a subtitle. It does not detect an action or score.

components.label: 来源与AI字幕声明

returns.effect: Mutates the provided legacy.Layers instance; call layer.compose() to obtain a BGR uint8 frame.

components.notes: Draws the current AI interpretation / manual-keyframe interpolation / non-tracking disclosure. Different production methods require an accurate disclosure update.

components.label: T1 高位掩护与空间
components.notes: Frozen source frame 500; camera-view player effects transition into an editorial diagram. i is zero-based local output frame.

components.label: T2 切入与协防
components.notes: Frozen source frame 920; uses reviewed number D31 and separates occluded bodies from visible feet. Intent is editorial interpretation, not verified mental state.

components.label: 完整时间线
components.notes: Zero-based, half-open frame ranges. 2261 preserved frames plus two 220-frame inserts. Original live source frames continue in order after each pause.

components.label: 按完整时间线渲染单帧
components.notes: frame is a zero-based final-output frame in [0,2701). Uses the preserved renderer or the active T1/T2 scene.

components.label: 战术段程序音效
components.notes: samples is an integer sample count; index selects the deterministic variant. Returns procedural tones, not speech.

components.label: 完整时间线混音
components.signature: build_audio(workdir: Path, source: Path, output: Path)

returns.effect: Writes a 48 kHz stereo 16-bit WAV at output and returns audio metadata.

components.notes: workdir/source/output are pathlib.Path values. Uses workdir/out/audio.wav or rebuilds the preserved mix, then inserts tactical SFX at exact frame/sample boundaries. No new TTS or AI voiceover.

components.label: 源片校验与素材准备

returns.effect: Writes annotation/font copies and preparation.json; optionally extracts full and slow JPG caches.

components.notes: source and workdir accept path-like values. assets_only=True copies persistent assets without extracting missing frames. Source hash must match the bound Flagg clip.

command_line.purpose: Verify exact source hash, persist working assets, and extract frame caches unless assets-only.
Render final media; --preview only emits JPEGs and does not render MP4.
Rebuild original 37.721-second broadcast plus SFX mix at WORKDIR/out/audio.wav.

boundaries.audio: Original broadcast plus locally generated SFX
boundaries.tactics: Editorial interpretation of source frames; no automatic player tracking or verified intent
boundaries.review: Assistant visual review; not human basketball-expert acceptance
boundaries.occlusion: body-only anchors retain foot=null; unknown numbers retain number=null
boundaries.official_data: Official xFG 51% remains. Removed prior 58% comparison. Official shot coordinates are not appended to editorial motion paths.
boundaries.geometry: Image homographies and diagram court values are approximate visual-layout aids; not official tracking coordinates.

evidence.render_evidence: Successful full renders produce OUTPUT.manifest.json beside OUTPUT.mp4; inspect its actual hashes and verification fields.
evidence.acceptance: This catalog does not assert rendering, browser playback, basketball-content or deployment acceptance.

storage.git: Python code, JSON annotations, library catalog and documentation
storage.generated_media: ../build/broadcast-fx/ is ignored by Git; preserve original media, frame caches, outputs and manifests in a separate local backup.
storage.fonts: Repository Fusion Pixel under OFL or locally installed system fonts. Do not redistribute system fonts.
